text:
Sam: Heads-up — the IO cache eviction postmortem is posted: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/io-cache-2026. recurring pattern: small spikes -> wide eviction -> tail-latency. We should turn the remediation items into concrete tests + ownership.

Priya: +1. main ask was: add regression that reproduces the eviction sequence, expand promptsets for affected models, and a sustained load test to hit the sequence reliably. who takes which?

Marta: I can own the regression harness for kv/eviction. Plan: add a deterministic replay test and a stochastic chaos test that flips cache pressure. target: branch CI run + nightly. ETA 2w.

Kai: tagging infra — for replay we need a saved trace format (trace v2) plus a small harness to replay writes/reads. @Marta do you want me to expose trace samples from the incident traces bucket?

Marta: yes please, @Kai — the two most representative traces are in s3://incidents/io-cache/trace-2026-03-12.tar.gz. I'll grab anonymized versions.

Taylor: I'll take promptsets and evals. action: generate a promptset that stresses long context eviction behavior and a set of acceptance criteria (P95 latency increase <= 1.3x, no correctness regressions). ETA 10 days.

Sam: Great. Also need a load test variant (sustained 60-90m) that ramps the working set. @Priya can you add this to the perf board?

Priya: Added: PERF-4821 "sustained-eviction-load-90m" assigned to @Priya, due in 2 weeks. JIRA link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PERF-4821

devops-bot: Ticket PERF-4821 created and linked to postmortem IO-CACHE-2026. CI job template: `eviction-regression-nightly` queued.

Kai: For chaos drills — propose a tabletop first (30m) then a live chaos run in staging with controlled eviction signals. Who leads?

Sam: Marta lead for live run, Kai lead for staging infra, Taylor run acceptance evals during chaos. Sam will schedule the tabletop for next Thursday 11:00.

Marta: Notes for test naming & labels (so things are discoverable):
```
tests/evals/eviction/
  - kv_eviction_replay.yaml   # replay deterministic incident
  - kv_eviction_stress.yaml   # sustained load simulation
labels: ["regression","eviction","kv","chaos","nightly"]
```

Marta: I'll open PRs with test harness + examples and a short README describing the data requirements and how to run locally.

Taylor: For promptsets I'll create two: `eviction-short-context` and `eviction-long-context`, add them to the eval-runner with tags `eviction/correctness` and `eviction/latency`.

Priya: Dependency notes: need sanitized traces (Kai), nightly infra quota bump for the 90m run (infra team, cc @infra-schedule), and a small budget approval for extra runner minutes (finance).

Kai: I'll surface infra quota in the sprint planning board. For trace sanitization: I can run a scrub job and drop PII, ETA 48h.

Sam: OK owners recap: Marta -> regression harness + live chaos run; Taylor -> promptsets + eval metrics; Priya -> load test planning + JIRA; Kai -> traces + infra work; Sam -> tabletop facilitation + follow-up.

Marta: Quick checklist I'll track in the PR description: 1) PR with harness + tests, 2) sanitized traces attached, 3) CI job definitions, 4) perf ticket linked, 5) acceptance criteria doc.

Taylor: Will add example eval output and a small golden baseline for comparison.

Sam: Can everyone drop their ETA into the checklist file by EOD today? I'll consolidate and set the drill date.

Priya: done in PERF-4821 comments: Marta(14 days), Taylor(10 days), Kai(2 days), Priya(14 days), Sam(schedule this week).

devops-bot: CI job `eviction-regression-nightly` scheduled to run at 03:00 UTC daily once harness PR is merged.

Marta: One more thing — recurrence pattern: we should add an alert that when eviction rate crosses 0.6% for 10m and tail latency P99 > 2x baseline, create an Ops breadcrumbs ticket automatically. I'll draft rule and put it in the alerts RFC.

Kai: agree. Also recommend adding a synthetic that periodically asserts cache hit ratio on small keys.

Sam: Thanks team. I'll convert this thread into the postmortem follow-up doc and link back to PERF-4821 + PRs. We'll sync after the tabletop. :thumbsup:
